sections.text: Queue backend. We need a job queue for deferred sends. SQS is managed and durable; a Redis list is in-process-fast but loses jobs on restart; a Postgres SKIP LOCKED queue reuses our existing database. Each has clear tradeoffs around durability, ops burden, and latency. The section lays out all three but does not commit to one.

Idempotency key. Every enqueued job carries a key so a redelivery is a no-op. Chosen: a SHA-256 of (job-type, payload, target) — deterministic, collision-resistant, and computable without extra state.
